text: cool thanks :D uh so let me show u another weird bug with building placement. so if i draw a single wall, and lets say i have a 1x2 so 6 walls to wrap it. if i place single walls, the edges do not align. if i however place multiple walls at a time, like by just tracing a long stroke, the walls then align. that can be seen here [Image #4] the bottom floor is the single wall placement when the floor above isnt. the bottom floor is all off because of it
resolution: Single-click walls misaligned because EVERY wall placement path snapped its line to the WORLD-anchored 3m module lattice (round(hit/3)*3) — never to the building being extended. For buildings sitting on that lattice the two coincide, but an off-lattice building (Alt fine placement from req_0650, a 1-tile building move, corner-turned runs at edge+1.5) makes each single click re-derive its own lattice line 1-2 tiles off the pad and off each other, while a drag stroke pins ONE line at drag start and stays self-consistent — exactly the reported symptom. Fix: nearestWallLineAnchor in editors/build/snap.ts — edge snap prefers REAL geometry: plate-top clicks anchor to that plate's edges + its own run lattice, wall-top clicks stack on the wall below's exact line/run, ground clicks within 1m (new wallAnchorMagnetMeters P2 tuning row) of an existing wall line or plate edge inherit it; world lattice is only the open-space fallback. Iso drag strokes (computePaint) anchor through the same helper so singles and strokes agree by construction. Alt fine mode opts out. 3 new P4 tests; suite 25/25 incl. all 19 pre-existing behaviors.
